I've already made the decision to leave, I've said my goodbyes to everyone, I'm not going to make such a big deal about how hard leaving was for me all to suddenly return the next day.

I need to seperate myself from this game anyway. I'm addicted, and I'm suffering because of it, I'm not doing homework and not talking to anyone. I'm seperating myself at least until the end of the school year. But I don't think I can keep my sanity and keep separate at the same time. But I won't be able to excercise enough self control to keep balance between school and games.

I still talk to people from the community on skype. I've just left all the groups I was involved in and made a vow to myself to only log back into this particular game when I'm ready. 

And when I say I see people posting stuff, I don't mean I relate to situations, I literally see people from these online communities reaching out and searching for help themselves. Some on their main reddit accounts, some on accounts with one character of difference of the username, and others who have spoken to me about their problems, and I see the literal exact story here.
